faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Detona Games.

items.a: A game walkthrough portal with system requirements, a hardware compatibility checker, XP, achievements, and a community that comments on and rates games.

items.q: How does the hardware compatibility checker work?
items.a: You enter your processor, graphics card and RAM, and we compare it against the game's requirements using a reference component table. It's a good estimate, not an exact measurement.

The minimum iOS version really comes from the App Store. RAM, storage and the minimum Android version are estimates, since there's no official public source for mobile game specs the way there is for Steam.
15 XP for logging in (once per day), 50 XP the first time you comment on or rate each game, and variable XP for unlocking achievements.

items.q: What are Points and the Shop?
items.a: Every 100 XP you accumulate earns 1 Point. Spend points on a name color, avatar frame and profile icons in the Shop.
User is the default. Moderator moderates comments and fixes existing games. Administrator has full control, including creating/deleting games and site settings.
Yes — a first-party cookie remembers which genres you view most, to suggest similar games, even if you're not logged in. This data is never sold or shared with third parties.

items.q: How does the Free Games section work?
items.a: We show limited-time free game offers on Steam, Epic Games, GOG, PlayStation and Xbox, using public data from GamerPower. Redemption always happens on each store's official site.

items.q: Can I become a Moderator or Administrator?
items.a: Only an Administrator can promote other users to Moderator or Administrator, from the panel at /admin/users.
